title: Acute Training Load Source Observations
description: Garmin source-provided load observations; the tool does not recalculate ratios or select one canonical observation per day.

observation_timestamp.description: Source timestamp normalized from epoch milliseconds to a UTC ISO-8601 instant.

disagreeing_fields.description: Starting with v2.0.0: the fields of this row whose values differ between the observations of its stable key, in field order. Those fields are null, and the dataset's audit keeps every observed value. Empty when the observations agree.
